people.name: William John Donaghy
people.birthPlace: Agnew's Lane, Larne, at marriage (1871) and at Robert’s birth (1879); died Main Street, Larne
people.marriage: High confidence: married Mary Ann McConell, 29 Oct 1871, Larne.
people.note: He married Mary Ann McConell on 29 October 1871 in Larne, and lived on Agnew's Lane. Their son Robert was born there on 19 October 1879, when William was recorded as a labourer. He died on 19 March 1903 on Main Street, Larne, aged 53, so he was born about 1850. He may also be the father named at Robert's probable 1906 marriage; the family has not yet confirmed that link.

people.name: Robert Donaghy
people.birthPlace: Agnew's Lane, Larne, Co. Antrim (civil birth); of Newtown, Carnlough at the 1906 marriage
people.marriage: Probable match: married Ellen Magill, 30 Sep 1906, RC chapel of Carnlough, Glenarm/Larne, Co. Antrim. Not yet family-confirmed.
people.note: Family-confirmed as Phyllis's father. He was born on 19 October 1879 on Agnew's Lane, Larne, to William John and Mary Ann Donaghy. A civil record shows a Robert Donaghy, a labourer of Newtown, Carnlough, marrying Ellen Magill on 30 September 1906 at the Roman Catholic chapel in Carnlough. That match is probable but not yet confirmed by the family. Five later Larne births with those parents are treated as Phyllis's probable siblings. A family member has said Nan's mum's maiden name may have been Magill, and remembered talk of well-to-do Magill cousins in Belfast; that supports the identification but does not confirm it.

people.name: Ellen Donaghy
people.birthPlace: Carnlough, Co. Antrim (civil birth; Glenarm district / Larne Union)
people.marriage: Probable match: Robert Donaghy married Ellen Magill, 30 Sep 1906, RC chapel of Carnlough, Glenarm/Larne, Co. Antrim. Not yet family-confirmed.
people.note: Family-confirmed as Phyllis's mother. Her maiden name was Magill, also recorded as McGill. A civil birth for Ellen McGill on 4 October 1880 in Carnlough names her parents as Thomas McGill, a carpenter, and Mary formerly Wilson, confirming the 1879 Glenarm marriage of Thomas Magill and Mary Wilson as her parents. A civil record shows Ellen Magill, of Newtown, Carnlough, marrying Robert Donaghy on 30 September 1906 at the Roman Catholic chapel in Carnlough; her father was Thomas Magill, a labourer. That marriage match is probable but not yet confirmed by the family. The 1906 record described her as a minor, which would imply a birth about 1886 to 1888, so it sits awkwardly with an 1880 birth (she would have been about 25). Five later Larne births with those parents are treated as Phyllis's probable siblings. A family member has said Nan's mum's maiden name may have been Magill, and remembered talk of well-to-do Magill cousins in Belfast; that supports the identification but does not confirm it.

people.name: Phyllis Cooke
people.note: Family-confirmed. Her birth certificate spells her name Phillis, and she insisted her name was Phillimena. Official records also use Philomena and Phyllis. Born on 7 July 1923, died on 15 August 2014; her death was registered in Hounslow. Her parents were Ellen and Robert Donaghy. She and John married on 14 October 1943; the place is not yet known and may have been in Northern Ireland. Her own birth was not found in Irish records, which fits a Northern Ireland birth. Her parents are a probable match for a 1906 Carnlough marriage of Robert Donaghy and Ellen Magill, not yet confirmed by the family.
